title: Every full-dimensional finite subset of real d-space for d at least four has difference set size at least the sharp coefficient two d minus two plus one over d minus one times its size, up to a dimension-dependent power-saving error
author: Akshat Mudgal
difficulty_reason: After the precisely stated small-doubling line-cover theorem and classical dimensional sumset bounds, the author still couples induction on dimension with induction on the number of parallel fibers and separates the resulting difference-set pieces. The full new asymmetric sumset bound requires several structural compressions that preserve projection counts and force three canonical configurations, followed by all fiber-mass and dimension cases. Those constructions supply the extra one over d minus one in the main coefficient and control discarded points through a dimension-drop argument, leaving a nonroutine geometric-combinatorial proof beyond ordinary qualification sumset inequalities; the original main outcome is conservatively H1.
work: New Lower Bounds for Cardinalities of Higher Dimensional Difference Sets and Sumsets

source_check.note: Only original Theorem 1.2 is selected, in the original scope $d\geq4$, finite nonempty $A\subseteq\mathbb R^d$ and affine dimension $d$, with the exact main coefficient and dimension-dependent power-saving error. The full printed body through Section 7 and complete bibliography are editable, including the small-doubling/discarded-point reduction, Proposition 3.1, simultaneous P/Q induction, rational embedding, every structural compression lemma and both complete asymmetric-sumset branches. Ordinary named prerequisites are Ruzsa [7] dimensional sumset bound as Lemma 2.1; Stanchescu [8] three-dimensional base case as Lemma 2.2; Mudgal [5] small-doubling line cover as Lemma 2.3; Grynkiewicz--Serra [4, Theorem 1.3] planar bound as Lemma 2.4; Tao--Vu [10, Corollary 2.12] sum-difference inequality as Lemma 2.5 and [10, Lemma 5.13] introductory dimensional bound; Gardner--Gronchi [3, Corollary 3.5 and Corollary 2.6 proof] nonincreasing sumset compression and preservation fact as source Lemmas 5.2/5.3. All locally new compression constructions and proof cases remain included. Authentic literal source quirks are retained, including the $2d^2r/4d^2r$ forms in Proposition 3.1 and the Q closing at 426, $r_i=\pi_d(\cdot)$ forms at 448, the union and unclosed parenthesis forms in the compression paragraph at 576, set-valued projections equated to counts at 640/654, the $A_2$ choice at 612 and the source reference to equation 5.1 as a lemma at 738. No mathematical verdict, numeral/index/set-operation repair or new bridge is supplied. The original unspecified dimension-dependent error remains unchanged. Source acknowledgement explicitly distinguishes Conlon--Lim [1] sharper constant-error work; that result is not counted here. Restricted-difference, asymmetric-sumset and stability consequences share the main construction and count zero. Full current page/formula/glyph QA complete; actual stable fresh compile passes and exhaustive diagnostics retained.
